en: Ephesians 1

p.src: 1  Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:

ja: によってキリスト・イエスの
とされたパウロから、エペソにいる
たち、すなわちキリスト・イエスにあって
en: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:
u.src: 1  Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:

ja: 1:1 「キリスト」は「油を注がれた者」という意味である。
en: 1:1 “Christ” means “Anointed One”.

p.src: 2  Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

ja: イエス・キリストから、
があなたがたにありますように。
en: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
u.src: 2  Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

p.src: 3  Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,

ja: が、ほめたたえられますように。
en: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,
u.src: 3  Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,

p.src: 4  even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love,

ja: から、御前で聖なる、傷のない者となるよう、愛のうちにキリストにあって
en: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love,
u.src: 4  even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love,

p.src: 5  having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,

ja: い、イエス・キリストを通して
として迎えることを、あらかじめ
en: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,
u.src: 5  having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,

p.src: 6  to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved.

ja: たちに惜しみなく注いでくださった、
みがほめたたえられるためです。
en: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved.
u.src: 6  to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved.

p.src: 7  In him we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace

ja: しを受けています。これは
en: In him we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace
u.src: 7  In him we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace

p.src: 8  which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,

ja: と分別をもって、この恵みを
en: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,
u.src: 8  which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,

p.src: 9  making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him

ja: らせてくださいました。それは、神が御心の喜びに従って、キリストにあってあらかじめ定めておられたものです。
en: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him
u.src: 9  making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him

p.src: 10  to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in him.

ja: にあるものも、すべてをキリストにあって
つにまとめることです。
en: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in him.
u.src: 10  to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in him.

p.src: 11  We were also assigned an inheritance in him, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who does all things after the counsel of his will,

ja: たちはキリストにあって
ける者とされました。ご自分の御心の
ってすべてを行われる
en: We were also assigned an inheritance in him, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who does all things after the counsel of his will,
u.src: 11  We were also assigned an inheritance in him, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who does all things after the counsel of his will,

p.src: 12  to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ.

ja: それは、先にキリストに
en: to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ.
u.src: 12  to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ.

p.src: 13  In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,

ja: あなたがたもキリストにあって、
en: In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,
u.src: 13  In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,

p.src: 14  who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.

ja: われる日まで、私たちの相続を保証する手付です。それは、
がほめたたえられるためです。
en: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.
u.src: 14  who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.

1:14 原文是質
1:14 民：原文是產業

ja: も、主イエスに対するあなたがたの
en: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you and the love which you have toward all the saints,
u.src: 15  For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you and the love which you have toward all the saints,

p.src: 16  don’t cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,

ja: 絶えずあなたがたのために
en: don’t cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,
u.src: 16  don’t cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,

ja: が、ご自分を深く知るための
えてくださいますように。
en: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him,
u.src: 17  that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him,

p.src: 18  having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

ja: みがどのようなものか、
ることができますように。
en: having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
u.src: 18  having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

ja: 1:18 公認本文では「心」の代わりに「理解力」としている。
en: 1:18 TR reads “understanding” instead of “hearts”

p.src: 19  and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might

ja: が、どれほど計り知れず偉
ることができますように。その力は、
en: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might
u.src: 19  and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might

p.src: 20  which he worked in Christ when he raised him from the dead and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,

en: which he worked in Christ when he raised him from the dead and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,
u.src: 20  which he worked in Christ when he raised him from the dead and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,

ja: のはるか上に置かれ、この時代だけでなく来るべき時代においても、呼ばれるあらゆる

en: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,

p.src: 23  which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.

ja: はキリストの体であり、すべてのものをあらゆるところに
